## Introduction

This outlines detailed, step-by-step instructions for accurately documenting and reporting failed building fire-safety checks.  A clear, thorough, and objective record is crucial for legal compliance, ensuring occupant safety, and facilitating prompt corrective action.  These instructions are applicable to fire inspectors, building maintenance personnel, and anyone responsible for conducting or documenting fire-safety inspections.
